title: Protein gel blot analysis
protocol: Grow yeast cells carrying the empty vector pDR-AMT1 in liquid YNB media supplemented with 3% glucose and 5mM arginine.
Harvest cells at OD600 0.6-0.8 and chill on ice.
Centrifuge harvested cells from 100 mL culture at 5,000g for 10 min at 4°C.
Wash pelleted cells once with half volume of chilled water.
Resuspend cells in 200 μL of chilled extraction buffer.
Disrupt resuspended cells using glass beads.
Lyse cells through vortexing for 30 sec followed by ice incubation, repeat for 10 cycles.
Centrifuge lysed cells at 12,000g for 5 min to collect supernatants.
Resuspend cell debris and glass beads in 1 mL of extraction buffer.
Vortex resuspended material twice for 30 sec each.
Centrifuge again to collect supernatant, pooling with the first one.
Harvest microsomal fraction by centrifugation at 100,000g for 50 min at 4°C.
Resuspend pellet in 200 μL of storage buffer.
Estimate protein concentration using Bradford protein assay with BSA as standard.
Denature proteins in loading buffer at 37°C for 30 min.
Separate denatured proteins on 10% SDS-PAGE gels.
Transfer proteins to PVDF membrane.
Raise a polyclonal antibody against the C-terminus of AMT1;1.
Affinity-purify the primary antibody.
Dilute the primary antibody at a ratio of 1/1,000 in blocking solution.
Dilute the secondary antibody at a ratio of 1/10,000 in blocking solution.
Use rainbow marker as a molecular mass standard.
Develop blots using SuperSignal West Pico Chemiluminescent Substrate.
